note: Another very quiet week for administration hires, exits, and contracts across all fifteen entities. The one item that cleared the 7-day window was an East Porter County board decision on a campus trespass ban tied to a coach-altercation dispute.

stories.headline: East Porter County board upholds campus trespass ban tied to volleyball altercation
stories.body: The East Porter County School Board voted to uphold a no-trespass order barring Brett Wescher and Michael Ready, husband of Kouts Middle/High School volleyball coach Lara Ready, from district property, stemming from a physical altercation after practice last fall.
